title: Indexes derived from the persistence declaration
description: The rendered schema indexes rates(currency, date). Each is implied by the declaration — a foreign key is looked up by its child column, and a read pattern's Input fields are the predicate it filters on. Declare an `- INDEX (...)` bullet in DATABASE.md for any index this does not cover.

title: Acceptance criterion api-test-client proves nothing
description:
FEATURE-API-Foundation.md [api-test-client]: accepts [200, 404]: 404 means the endpoint is absent, so this passes against an application that implements nothing. Assert 404 alone for a negative probe, or assert the status the implementation answers with. (assert response.status_code in (200, 404))

A criterion states one expectation. Pin the status the implementation answers with — a stub that answers is a real contract and a real test — or assert the not-found status alone as a deliberate negative probe. A criterion that needs a row to exist creates it through the public interface first rather than admitting the status that says it never existed.
